<!--
Thanks for contributing to ship-it! Security fixes: stop here and follow SECURITY.md.

Write for a reviewer who has not worked in this part of the code, and keep the
pull request self-contained: describe the change, its reason and the evidence
here, not in private conversations.

`ship` fills the sections it has facts for (summary from your commit bodies,
issue, AI usage) and leaves the others to you. The title follows
docs/reference/conventions.md (`ship check title -- "<title>"`), and every commit is
signed off (`git commit -s`, CONTRIBUTING.md).
-->

What changes and why. The problem first, then why this approach; mention

## How did you test this change?

Only what you actually did and saw, in the first person ("I ran…", "I saw…"):

Do not paste `go test` output or coverage: CI already shows it.

If you did not exercise the change yourself, write `Not tested manually` and
say why.
-->
